note_en: 明明 means "clearly, obviously" and sets up a contradiction that follows with 可/却/但: 公司明明没有规定必须加班，可几乎所有人都主动留到很晚 "the company clearly has no rule requiring overtime, yet almost everyone stays late." English conveys this indignant tone through intonation or "even though," while Chinese signals it in advance with 明明.
